turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on weather words?
turns.tutor:
Let me show you one first: Wear a coat. It is ___ today.
Step 1: look at the clue: a coat. Step 2: we wear a coat to stay warm, so the weather is not warm. Result: Wear a coat.
The rule: read the clue, think what weather it tells you, then write that weather word.
Right: There are no clouds. It is sunny. Wrong: There are no clouds. It is cloudy.
Now you. Write the missing word.
Complete: "Take an umbrella. It is ___ today."
